answer.reason: Moldova's demographic profile is characterized by very low fertility, heavy emigration, and rapid population aging, so its share of children is far below 20% by 2023. Regional comparators with similarly low fertility (Ukraine, Bulgaria, Romania) all show 0-14 shares around 13-16%, and Moldova's own trend (roughly 18-19% around 2019-2020, declining thereafter, with census revisions further lowering estimates) points to approximately 15% in 2023. Thus option B (~15.01%) is the supported value, matching the supplied draft answer, while option A (~19.99%) is implausibly high for Moldova in 2023.
